output.title: BR-04 each line is converted and rounded to the customer's currency before its tax is worked out, and the total adds up the rounded lines @critical
output.data_choice: P-1132 is the only free project billed in a foreign currency: Polar Marine Oy, USD, standard VAT 25.5%. Its one line is 0.5 h at 85.00 EUR = 42.50 EUR, which converts at 1.0835 to an unrounded 46.04875 USD and rounds to 46.05. However, tax on the unrounded amount (11.742…) and on the rounded line (11.74275) both round to 11.74, so this data would not show BILL-1203 again. None of the free data can, so engineers should seed a dedicated project. The material also does not say whether a proposal can be created for a project in Closing status.
